newsitem.title: USA: Micron names Stevenson as president.
newsitem.headline: Micron names Stevenson as president.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc named Gregory Stevenson, 36, as president of Micron Electronics Inc.

Stevenson previously served as executive vice president, operations and chief operating officer. In addition to his new title, Stevenson will retain his title as chief operating officer of the company and will continue to serve on the board.
Joseph Daltoso, immediate past President of Micron Electronics, Inc., will continue to serve as chairman and chief executive officer of the company.
Micron Electronics and its subsidiaries manufacture electronic products and provide services for a range of computing and digital applications.
